mechanics.claim: Mortal Steel applies on-hit and on-attack effects to the first enemy hit only, not secondary enemies.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: The first target hit takes basic (single-target) damage, while secondary targets take area damage, affecting damage amp/reduction interactions.
mechanics.quote: ''Mortal Steel'' applies {{tip|basic damage}} for {{tt|the first (closest) enemy hit|including enemies hit by the dash}} and {{tip|area damage}} for secondary enemies

mechanics.claim: Life steal only heals from damage dealt to the first target hit.
mechanics.quote: {{as|{{sti|Life steal}}}} will heal based on the damage dealt to the first target hit.

mechanics.claim: All three parts of the ability (thrust, whirlwind, dash) can individually critically strike.
mechanics.quote: All three of the thrust, whirlwind and dash roll for a critical strike on each individual target hit.

mechanics.claim: Mortal Steel does not benefit from the bonus attack speed granted by Hail of Blades.
mechanics.quote: ''Mortal Steel'' will not benefit from the bonus attack speed gained by {{ri|Hail of Blades}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered (Gathering Storm) cast cannot hit the same target twice with both dash and whirlwind.
mechanics.quote: being unable to affect the same target twice
